text: Cool idea. This is the right mug if you use those powdered drink packets because after you put the powder in you can mix it really well in the cup. Sometimes the powders do not dissolve totally so you can just turn it on And mix it in this  mug.

product_metadata.title: S+ Stainless Steel Self Stirring Mug Suitable for Coffee/Milk/fruit juice (Pink)
features: 【Design Idea】This coffee mixing mug has a round and slender body which gives people a pleasant mood, which is the designer's idea. Simplicity and practicality are the themes of our product design and also are the most simple values of this product.

【Battery Selection 】This coffee mixing mug Powered by two 3A batteries, We choose to use 3A batteries, apart from Safety,simple and reliable , the mainly factors is the lithium batteries and other polymer batteries will make the product structure more complicated,and it requiring more additional transportation conditions and maintenance costs. The most import and so apologetic thing is that you need to buy the 3A battery yourself.
【Motor】The motor used in this mix mug has been debugged many times by engineers to ensure a better user experience for the mixing cup. We think this work is very valuable.

【Material Description】The coffee mixing cup is made of food-grade 304 stainless steel, the shell is ABS, the mixing propeller is environmentally friendly food-grade plastic, and the waterproof ring is food-grade silicone.you can use it with confidence.

【Volume & Usage and Cleaning】The coffe mixing mug's max volume is 340ML.during normal use, please use a rag or wet paper towel with water to clean the surface of the cup.to clean the inside of the cup, you can use the mixing function of the cup. UV sterilization is not allowed, and it cannot be used in microwave ovens.for other notices, please refer to the manual.

【Warming tips】When the propeller cannot rotate with the battery charged, you need to turn the propeller with a spoon to loosen it (the last time the stirred liquid was not cleaned, making the propeller and the airtight silicone surface bonded so that it cannot rotate).
【customer service】According to Amazon Customer Service Terms.
